messages:
alex: quick ping — PR #4123 updates the REST client to forward `x-rw-route` header for streaming/toolcall paths. Need one +1 and a merge window today (cut at 17:00 PT). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4123
marina: on it, will run the integration suite and skim code. do we need a migration note? :thinking_face:
devon: reproducing locally, failing at `tests/test_toolcall_headers.py::test_header_forwarding` — looks like a flaky timeout right now, running with -k header to be sure
devon: `pytest tests/test_toolcall_headers.py::test_header_forwarding -q`
alex: thanks — the change is just a tiny shim: in rest-client we set `request.headers['x-rw-route'] = request.headers.get('x-route')` when absent. fallback only, no breaking rename.
tanvi: that seems fine to me. please add a short changelog bullet and note the behavior in the SDK migration doc. also add a unit covering the streaming path.
marina: pushed a quick test fix and an extra unit. force-pushed to the branch — CI retriggered.
ci-bot: CI: integration-tests queued for ref 8b3f2d — https://ci.redwood/4123/logs
ci-bot: CI: all checks passed ✅ — integration, lint, unit, e2e. deploy-preview available.
devon: LGTM from my side. left a small comment to squash the two debug commits.
alex: awesome, thanks all. I'll squash and merge in the 16:30 PT merge window unless anyone objects. If we need a rollback plan, best to tag the previous stable and keep the canary routing enabled for 30m after deploy. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
marina: nope, no objections. I'll monitor traces and latency dashboards after merge.
tanvi: thanks — add the changelog line and migration note then go for it. :+1:
alex: done, changelog added and commits squashed. merging in 5.
ci-bot: Merged by alex — https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/commit/9f4a1b2 (PR #4123)
marina: watching metrics, all green so far :)
devon: good ship it. :shipit:
